name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulders, lower to chest, press up

name: Squat
instructions: Bar on upper back, feet shoulder-width, sit back and down, drive through heels

name: Deadlift
instructions: Feet hip-width, grip bar, keep back straight, stand up by extending hips

name: Pull-ups
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip, pull up until chin over bar, lower with control

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Bar at shoulder height, press overhead until arms straight, lower with control

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Bent over, back flat, pull bar to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades

name: Incline Bench Press
instructions: On incline bench 30-45 degrees, press bar from chest to arms extended

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Bar at thighs, hinge at hips keeping legs mostly straight, feel hamstring stretch

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at machine, grip bar wide, pull to upper chest, squeeze shoulder blades

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, curl up rotating palms forward, squeeze biceps

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at cable machine, push bar down until arms straight, control return

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in machine, feet on platform, push until legs nearly straight, control descent

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Dumbbells at shoulders, press overhead until arms straight, lower with control

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down, curl weight up to glutes, lower with control

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with balls of feet on edge, raise heels as high as possible, lower below platform

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on ground, body straight from head to heels, hold position

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: One hand and knee on bench, pull dumbbell to hip, squeeze shoulder blade

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, raise arms to sides until parallel to floor

name: Face Pull
instructions: Stand at cable, pull rope to face, elbows high, squeeze shoulder blades

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells, palms facing each other, curl up keeping palms neutral

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest, squat down keeping chest up, drive through heels

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with upper back on bench, bar on hips, thrust upward squeezing glutes

name: Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells above chest, open arms wide with slight bend, bring back together

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with feet braced, pull handle to torso, squeeze shoulder blades, control return

name: Front Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells in front to shoulder height, keep arms slightly bent

name: Reverse Fly
instructions: Hinge at hips, raise arms out to sides until parallel, squeeze upper back

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, feet flat, lift hips by squeezing glutes, lower with control

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit on machine, extend legs fully, pause, lower with control

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand sideways to cable, raise arm to shoulder height, control descent

name: Cable Woodchopper
instructions: Pull cable diagonally across body using core rotation, control return
